Name: Battleship
Description: The classic Hasbro naval-combat game from Electronic Arts. Deploy your fleet and hunt the enemy across Classic and Salvo modes, unlock devastating super-weapons and call in reinforcements, then take the fight online in head-to-head multiplayer.

Achievements.Name: Back to Boot Camp
Achievements.Description: Miss 20 times before you hit a ship.

Achievements.Name: I Sunk Your Battleship
Achievements.Description: Sink your opponent's Battleship before any other ship. (Classic Mode only)

Achievements.Name: Eyes on the Target
Achievements.Description: Score a hit on your first Salvo. (Salvo Mode only)

Achievements.Name: On the Hunt
Achievements.Description: Hit all 5 ships in a single turn in Salvo Mode.

Achievements.Name: Gun Captain
Achievements.Description: Unlock all super weapons.

Achievements.Key: This is all I need to beat you
Achievements.Name: This Is All I Need to Beat You
Achievements.Description: Win a Super-weapons game without using any super weapons.

Achievements.Name: Reinforcements Did Not Come
Achievements.Description: Sink 5 Reinforcement ships.

Achievements.Name: Locking On
Achievements.Description: Hit at least one target on your first 3 turns. (Salvo Mode only)

Achievements.Name: No Blue Horizon
Achievements.Description: Sink 15 Aircraft Carriers. (Classic Mode only)

Achievements.Name: I See You
Achievements.Description: Hit your targets 250 times. (Classic Mode only)

Achievements.Name: Jack of All Trades
Achievements.Description: Play all game modes.

Achievements.Name: Buddy System
Achievements.Description: Finish a game with two ships still afloat next to each other.

Achievements.Name: Winning!
Achievements.Description: Win your very first multiplayer game.

Achievements.Name: Undisputed
Achievements.Description: Win 5 Salvo games without using Best of 5.

Achievements.Name: Sunk but Not Destroyed
Achievements.Description: Finish a game with your Destroyer still afloat.

Achievements.Name: Not So Sneaky
Achievements.Description: Sink 10 Recon Boats using Best of 5.

Achievements.Name: What Comes Around
Achievements.Description: After the enemy sinks your sub, return the favor on your next turn.

Achievements.Name: Down with the Ship
Achievements.Description: Win a game with only one ship and one hit remaining.

Achievements.Name: Commodore
Achievements.Description: Win 50 matches.

Achievements.Name: Admiral
Achievements.Description: Win 200 matches.
